UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,

Plaintiff,  v.  KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6,

Defendants. ____________________________________/

Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

EXHIBIT A — NOTICE OF SUBSEQUENT RECORD DEVELOPMENT RELEVANT TO ECF NOS. 93 AND 97–99

Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine gives notice of the following record development. It postdates Plaintiff’s consolidated reply in support of ECF Nos. 90 and 93 (ECF No. 102, filed October 28, 2026) and the filing of ECF Nos. 97–99 (October 23, 2026).

1.	On October 29, 2026, Magistrate Judge William E. Fitzpatrick signed an Order denying without prejudice Plaintiff’s Motion for Entry of a Scheduling Order and, as Necessary, an Initial Pretrial Conference (ECF No. 103) and Plaintiff’s Motion for an Order Directing Completion of the Rule 26(f) Conference and Submission of a Discovery Plan (ECF No. 105). The Order was filed October 29, 2026 and entered on the docket October 30, 2026 as ECF No. 108. The motions had been docketed October 29, 2026.

2.	ECF No. 108 states: “Here, the record reflects that the District Judge has chosen to refrain from beginning any discovery until resolution of the pending motions to dismiss.” ECF No. 108 at 2. It identifies no order or instruction of the District Judge as the source of that decision.

3.	ECF No. 108 is an adjudication entered under the successor designation recorded October 22, 2026. The authority and procedure that produced that designation are the subject of the request in ECF No. 97 ¶¶ 15 and 20(6) and ECF No. 99, Part V.

4.	ECF No. 108 bears on ECF No. 93 ¶ 10(R1) (withdrawal or modification of the referral), as maintained in the Proposed Supplement, ECF No. 99-1 ¶ 5. It bears on ECF No. 93 ¶ 10(R5) (interim protection), as maintained in ECF No. 99-1 ¶ 9. It bears on ECF No. 93 ¶ 10(R6) (coordinated determination). It bears on ECF No. 97 ¶ 20(6)–(7) (identification of the authority and procedure that produced the successor designation; coordinated determination).

5.	Plaintiff’s motions under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 54(b), filed November 1, 2026, request reconsideration of ECF No. 108 insofar as it denied ECF Nos. 103 and 105. This Notice requests no relief beyond that already requested in ECF Nos. 93 and 97–99.

Date: November 1, 2026		                      Respectfully submitted,

Marvelle J. Ballentine
